scope: Compare the normal vertical GTK2 endpoint cells from the currently installed DomainOS engine against the native HP VUE SR10.4 crop, and verify that the installed GTK2 runtime regenerates palette-bound assets after a semantic color input changes.

vertical_cells.runtime: GTK2 2.24.33; capture from the current installed DomainOS engine and active KDE palette
vertical_cells.method: Exact RGB, 1:1, 15x15 cells; located the unique exact match in the GTK2 capture without scaling or filtering.

palette_refresh.method: Ran the installed setup and refresh functions against a copied private theme/config/state root; no D-Bus, real XDG profile, open application, or desktop settings were touched.

result: The installed engine's normal vertical up/down cells match the SR10.4/VUE reference exactly (0/225 differences each). The installed palette runtime also updated the private GTK2 wrapper and retained domainos-pixbuf after its semantic color input changed.
